Microfiber car drying towels `absorb water fast and prevent scratches on your car paint` . Top choices include the waffle-weave **Meguiar's Water Magnet** (~$9), the ultra-plush twist-loop **The Liquid8r** from [The Rag Company](https://theragcompany.com/collections/drying-towels?srsltid=AfmBOor34rj1QipjvZavRak4-stYAVSJItVDjt_1XQRjCTlFVJUlygs6) , and the heavy-duty **The Gauntlet** dual-weave towel.[](https://theragcompany.com/products/the-liquid8r) [[1]](https://theragcompany.com/products/the-liquid8r)[[2]](https://www.newegg.com/p/0MB-02H4-000S2)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:78109024841704947,catalogid:3071506241905245235,gpcid:772369212557782855,mid:576462788810324043&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://theragcompany.com/products/dry-me-a-river)[[5]](https://theragcompany.com/products/the-gauntlet)

Types of Drying Towels

- **Waffle Weave:** Honeycomb pockets wick away water; great budget choice.
- **Twist Pile:** Long, twisted fibers hold massive amounts of water; glides smoothly.
- **Plush/Shag:** Thick and soft, best used with a pat-dry motion or drying aid.[](https://www.autofiber.com/collections/drying) [[1]](https://www.autofiber.com/collections/drying)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1195430047320429749,catalogid:15112927179637831068,gpcid:9312926917025452416,mid:576462820643195724&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qPwQYPsINwk&vl=en&t=73)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11133985200792438795,catalogid:1360624669247678208,gpcid:16700869975685261992&ibp=oshop)

Care Tips

- Wash in cold or warm water using a dedicated microfiber detergent like Rags to Riches.
- Never use fabric softener or dryer sheets (they clog the fibers and cause streaks).
- Tumble dry on low heat or hang dry.[](https://theragcompany.com/products/the-liquid8r) [[1]](https://www.obsessedgarage.com/blogs/og-knowledge-base/microfiber-car-cloths)[[2]](https://www.detailedimage.com/The-Rag-Company-M99/The-Gauntlet-Microfiber-Drying-Towel-P2191/Reviews/)[[3]](https://detailingshed.com.au/products/the-rag-company-rip-n-rag-multi-purpose-microfiber-towels-30x30)[[4]](https://www.amazon.co.za/VibraWipe-Microfiber-Cleaning-Washable-Lint-Free/dp/B00NDN4ZE8)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your **budget** 
- The **size** of your vehicle (sedan, large truck, RV)

I can recommend the ideal towel size and pack quantity for you.
